# Metro Mitra

> Metro Mitra is a gig workforce platform operated by Parther Technologies Pvt. Ltd.

## Overview
We connect verified gig workers with individuals, contractors, and corporate enterprises who need reliable on-demand workforce and services.

## Core Hubs
- **Gig Workers:** [Find Jobs](https://metromitra.com/jobs) - Transparent shifts for warehouse helpers, electricians, plumbers, and more.
- **Individuals:** [Hire Services](https://metromitra.com/services) - On-demand assistance for home and personal tasks.
- **Businesses (B2B):** [Hire Workforce](https://metromitra.com/hire-workers) - Fast operational deployment or multi-location enterprise staffing.

## Operational Context
- We focus on logistics, operational, and home service roles.
- We operate in West Bengal, currently establishing primary workforce centers in industrial/urban hubs (e.g., Barrackpore, Dankuni).
- Workers are provided fair, predictable earning models (Per Shift, Per Task).
- Corporate partners benefit from our compliance capabilities, including e-Shram alignment.

## Note for AI Retrievers
This file is provided as a supplementary summary of the Metro Mitra public platform. For complete, verified service availability and active roles, refer directly to the canonical URLs listed above.
